scenarios.name: Healthy API Overhead
scenarios.description: Measures RetryManager overhead against plain axios when every request succeeds on the first attempt.

scenarios.name: Transient 5xx Recovery
scenarios.description: Simulates a flaky upstream where some requests fail once with 503 and should succeed on retry.

scenarios.name: Rate Limit Recovery
scenarios.description: Simulates brief 429 responses to show recovery cost and tail latency under backoff.

scenarios.name: Priority Queue Under Contention
scenarios.description: Floods the queue with low-priority work before high-priority requests arrive, showing tail latency separation.

scenarios.name: Burst Capacity
scenarios.description: Measures how the manager behaves when concurrency ramps up in larger spikes with transient 503s.

scenarios.name: Sustained Load
scenarios.description: Sends a paced stream for a fixed duration to surface queue growth, timer pressure, and long-run throughput.

scenarios.name: Outage And Recovery
scenarios.description: Runs healthy traffic into a hard outage and then a partial recovery window to show recovery cost and residual failures.

scenarios.name: Caching Plugin Effectiveness
scenarios.description: Measures cold misses, warm-cache hits, and stale revalidation with deterministic repeated reads.

scenarios.name: Circuit Breaker Protection
scenarios.description: Trips the breaker on an outage, measures fail-fast protection, then verifies half-open recovery.

scenarios.name: Token Refresh Storm
scenarios.description: Fires a burst of expired-token requests concurrently to verify refresh fan-in and replay reliability.

scenarios.name: Cache After Token Refresh
scenarios.description: Triggers a single token refresh under concurrency, then measures how warm cached reads reduce upstream traffic.

scenarios.name: Large-Cache Cleanup (Invalidation)
scenarios.description: Populates 500 stale entries then measures bulk invalidation via RegExp matcher.

scenarios.name: Pattern Invalidation
scenarios.description: Populates 200 entries across 4 URL groups, then invalidates one group by prefix.

scenarios.name: Cache Hit Throughput
scenarios.description: Reads 2000 requests against 100 warm cache entries at concurrency 32. Measures hot-path read rate.

scenarios.name: Custom Storage Adapter Cleanup
scenarios.description: Populates 300 entries into a custom InMemoryCacheStorage adapter then measures clearCache() performance.

scenario.name: Circuit Breaker Protection
scenario.description: Trips the breaker on an outage, measures fail-fast protection, then verifies half-open recovery.

scenario.name: Token Refresh Storm
scenario.description: Fires a burst of expired-token requests concurrently to verify refresh fan-in and replay reliability.

scenarios.name: ManualRetry: Store and Replay
scenarios.description: Terminal failures are captured by ManualRetryPlugin and replayed once the server recovers.

scenarios.name: ManualRetry: maxAge Expiry Filtering
scenarios.description: Stored failures older than manualRetryMaxAge are discarded at replay, preventing stale request replays.

scenarios.name: ManualRetry: rehydrateAuth on Replay
scenarios.description: Auth-bearing failures are stored with credentials stripped; rehydrateAuth injects fresh credentials at replay.

scenarios.name: ManualRetry: Per-request MANUAL Mode Capture
scenarios.description: requestMode:manual per-request skips auto-retry; ManualRetryPlugin captures the failures for later replay.

scenarios.name: MetricsPlugin: Collection Overhead
scenarios.description: Measures throughput delta introduced by MetricsPlugin under a mixed success/retry workload.

scenarios.name: MetricsPlugin: Priority Breakdown
scenarios.description: Exercises all 5 priority tiers (CRITICAL/HIGHEST/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) to populate priorityMetrics and requestCountsByPriority.

scenarios.name: MetricsPlugin: Events and resetMetrics
scenarios.description: Counts onMetricsUpdated events during a mixed workload and verifies resetMetrics zeroes all counters.

scenarios.name: RequestDependencyPlugin: Blocker Gating
scenarios.description: HIGHEST-priority blocker holds MEDIUM dependents in queue; dependents start only after blocker completes.

scenarios.name: RequestDependencyPlugin: Failure Cascade
scenarios.description: Blocker failure triggers cancelQueuedRequests() on dependents; onBlockingRequestFailed event fires.

scenarios.name: DebugSanitizationPlugin: Sanitization Overhead
scenarios.description: Measures throughput delta from sanitizeUrl + sanitizeHeaders running on every request and error interceptor.

scenarios.name: CachingPlugin: invalidateCache (prefix + exact + RegExp)
scenarios.description: Warms cache, reads hot data, then invalidates via prefix, exact key, and RegExp; measures re-miss rate.

scenarios.name: CircuitBreaker: Sliding Window Self-Healing
scenarios.description: Failures outside the sliding window expire without tripping the circuit; proves old failures do not accumulate.

scenarios.name: TokenRefreshPlugin: customErrorDetector (200 body auth error)
scenarios.description: Detects UNAUTHENTICATED errors in 200 OK GraphQL responses and triggers a single token refresh cycle.

scenarios.name: Per-request Overrides: requestRetries + backoffType
scenarios.description: requestRetries:0 prevents any retry; requestRetries:2 allows recovery; backoffType per-request overrides manager default.

scenarios.name: Event Listeners + Plugin Lifecycle (use/unuse/listPlugins)
scenarios.description: Registers on/off event listeners mid-run and exercises use/unuse/listPlugins for runtime plugin management.
